M04_S2_03_GUESS.line: He's running with the case. I've got the wheel, and I've got him.
M04_S2_03_GUESS.trigger: The player takes Guess during the switch window, or the window closes

M28_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Surge unit connected. Hold them off while I bring the relay down.
M28_S1_01_GOHAN.trigger: Gohan begins the timed relay splice

M28_S1_02_ICE.line: Aegis patrol responding. Gohan, finish the splice. I've got the approach.
M28_S1_02_ICE.trigger: Response squad engages after initial yard clearance

M28_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Dish offline. Their northern teams just lost the shared feed. Let's get clear.

M29_S1_01_GUESS.line: Depot's clear. I'll take the road tanker. Ice, open the transfer valve.

M29_S1_02_ICE.line: Fuel transferred. Valve closed. Guess, get it to the bunker before another patrol arrives.
M29_S1_02_ICE.trigger: Ice completes the transfer at the depot

M29_S1_03_GUESS.line: Tanker parked at the bunker. Keep the generator running; I'll keep track of the gauge.

M30_S1_01_GUESS.line: Loose shale and a gunship behind me. Gohan, I need that sheltered route now.

M30_S1_02_GOHAN.line: Take the next bend into the canyon. The rock walls will give you cover.

M30_S1_03_GUESS.line: Parts are at the bunker, intact. Next delivery needs a bigger travel allowance.
M30_S1_03_GUESS.trigger: Specified parts truck delivered and unloaded

SM04_S1_01_ICE.line: Two Aegis marksmen watching the quarry road. I'll take the overlook and identify both positions.

SM04_S1_02_ICE.line: One down. The other still has a sightline on the road. Can't leave him there.

SM04_S2_03_ICE.line: Both down. Radios recovered. Gohan can listen for patrol calls; we'll still have to watch the road.
SM04_S2_03_ICE.trigger: Both marksmen eliminated and both radios collected

SM05_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Swamp's dark enough to hide a boat. Going in quiet. I'll call when I find the buoy.

SM05_S1_02_GOHAN.line: Buoy located. Fitting the interceptor at the service harness. Keep this channel open.

SM05_S2_03_GOHAN.line: Signal locked. We can read the flight traffic this buoy relays. Coming back to the pickup.

SM06_S1_01_GUESS.line: Aviation fuel, full load. Easy on the throttle. This thing only has to arrive in one piece.

SM06_S1_02_GUESS.line: Cartel bikes behind me! Gohan, keep the airfield gate clear.

SM06_S2_03_GUESS.line: Through the canyon. Still got the load. I'm taking the next bend slow, whether they like it or not.

SM06_S2_04_GUESS.line: Tanker at McKenzie, intact. Set this fuel aside for the rig operation.

M31_S1_03_ICE.line: Ambush stopped. Perimeter held this time. Restock it, and keep the withdrawal route open.

M33_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Ramos is breathing, but he's hurt. Get him through the wind farm. The codes can wait.

M37_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Smoke tanks are ready. They'll break visual contact, but radar and thermal crews can still find us.

M40_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Armor fitted and both boats water-tested. Keep the engines covered; this isn't a guarantee.

M48_S1_03_GOHAN.line: The ledgers name their people in Los Santos. We go home with evidence this time.

M50_S1_03_GOHAN.line: The local alerts are down. That buys us time, not an acquittal. Their backups still exist.

M53_S1_03_ICE.line: Sweep team down. This corridor is clear. Keep somebody watching the next junction.

M54_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Satellite link live. I'm marking the patrols transmitting nearby. Quiet teams won't show up.

M55_S1_02_GOHAN.line: Terminal bypassed at Arcadius! Sixty million identified. Copying the transfer authorizations!

M58_S1_03_GUESS.line: Their council's down. That breaks this command chain. Doesn't mean every crew in the city quits.

M59_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Broadcast is repeating. Independent copies are spreading. They can't silence this by taking one tower.

M65_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Biometrics accepted! Escrow control is open. I've got the authorizations; we finish the transfer outside.

M67_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Transfer confirmed. The money's accessible. It isn't invisible, so we still need to get out.

M70_S1_02_GOHAN.line: Third wave! Ice, still with me?

SM08_S2_04_GOHAN.line: The evidence proving they framed me is out. Clearing my name comes next. First, Ice and Guess need me.

M01_S1_01_ICE.line: Eyes on Mateo. He is checking a shipment with a dock technician. Keep him alive; the buyers are the real target.
M01_S1_01_ICE.direction: Quiet; watching the target from dock cover

M01_S1_02_GOHAN.line: Dock terminal is open. Copying the ledger. Just need a few seconds without an alarm.
M01_S1_02_GOHAN.trigger: Gohan begins the eight-second data copy

M01_S2_04_GOHAN.line: Alarm tripped! I've only got part of the ledger! Shooters coming into the yard!
M01_S2_04_GOHAN.trigger: Reference recognition line; replaced by the authored recognition scene

M01_S2_05_ICE.line: Wait... that voice. Devin? Gohan? What the hell are you doing in this yard?
M01_S2_05_ICE.trigger: Reference recognition line; replaced by the authored recognition scene

M01_S3_07_ICE.line: Mateo reached the launch. We have his ledger; we can follow the money. Get to the car!

M02_S1_01_GOHAN.line: That van has the dock footage. Keep me close enough to punch into their signal and I can kill the upload. Three minutes before our faces land.

M02_S1_02_GUESS.line: Black Rumpo. Satellite dome. I see it. Just keep doing whatever the hell you're doing back there.
M02_S1_02_GUESS.trigger: Chase car closes to the van

M02_S2_03_ICE.line: Halfway. They found the intrusion - guns in the windows! Keep working, Gohan. I'll cover our side.

M02_S2_04_GOHAN.line: I'm in. Upload cut, ignition disabled. The server's intact. Ice, take the drives.

M03_S1_01_GUESS.line: Rail junction locked. Their backup route is delayed. Ice, the depot approach is yours.
M03_S1_01_GUESS.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M03

M03_S1_02_ICE.line: Rail route's blocked. I'm moving on the depot. Gohan, stay ready for that truck.
M03_S1_02_ICE.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M03

M03_S2_03_ICE.line: Guards first. Nobody starts loading while they're shooting at the terminal.
M03_S2_03_ICE.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M03

M03_S2_04_GOHAN.line: Weapons loaded. Guess, the Benson's ours. We need that truck, not another car.
M03_S2_04_GOHAN.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M03

M03_S2_05_GUESS.line: I've got the weapons truck. Taking it to the foundry. Ice and Gohan, keep the depot clear until I'm out.
M03_S2_05_GUESS.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M03

M04_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Miller's meeting is in this surface lot. I'll take the breaker. Lights go out, the escort gets nervous.
M04_S1_01_GOHAN.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M04

M04_S1_02_ICE.line: Breaker cut. Escort's mine. Guess is waiting in the chase car.
M04_S1_02_ICE.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M04

M04_S2_03_GUESS.line: Escort's down. I've got the car. Once we're ready, we go after Miller on the surface streets.
M04_S2_03_GUESS.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M04

M04_S2_04_ICE.line: He's moving. Stop the car or stop Miller, then get me that drive. Don't let him pull away.
M04_S2_04_ICE.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M04

M04_S2_05_ICE.line: Drive secured. We have the meeting records. Let's see where Miller sent the money.
M04_S2_05_ICE.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M04

M05_S1_01_ICE.line: I'm covering the coast. Shore guards first, then the dinghy. Gohan's already riding with Guess.
M05_S1_01_ICE.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M05

M05_S1_02_GUESS.line: Flare away. Gohan, stay aboard. Either of us can drive; whoever's got hands free takes the wheel.
M05_S1_02_GUESS.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M05

M05_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Mateo's running. Stay on him with the dinghy and get us alongside. We need him alive.
M05_S1_03_GOHAN.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M05

M06_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Feeder's dead. Ice, entrance is yours. Guess stays with the getaway.
M06_S1_01_GOHAN.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M06

M06_S1_02_ICE.line: Moving in. Gohan, get to those racks. I'll hold the alley.
M06_S1_02_ICE.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M06

M06_S2_03_ICE.line: SWAT's stacking up outside. Keep working, Gohan. We leave when the burn is done and the alley's quiet.
M06_S2_03_ICE.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M06

M06_S2_04_GOHAN.line: Burn complete. The backup is gone. We're ready to leave.
M06_S2_04_GOHAN.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M06

M06_S2_05_GUESS.line: Granger's ready. Finish the burn and get your asses back here. Both of you.
M06_S2_05_GUESS.trigger: Matching playable objective event in M06

M07_S2_04_ICE.line: Aegis helicopter incoming. I need a way off this roof.

M07_S2_05_GUESS.line: I'm underneath you, Ice. Find a safe way down and I'll be there.

M07_S1_02_ICE.line: Receiver clamped. Pulling manifests... Gohan, what are these engines?

M07_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Aegis is shipping two military turbine engines to Paleto. That's our target.

M07_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Get me that receiver on the antenna and I'll pull whatever Aegis is moving.

M08_S2_05_GUESS.line: Chained down! Hitting the Del Perro connector!

M08_S2_03_GUESS.line: Crate one seated! Ice, armored technical coming up the boat ramp!

M08_S2_04_ICE.line: Technical is out. Guess, secure the second crate.

M08_S1_01_GUESS.line: Seven hundred horsepower, bulletproof casings, all-fuel intake. Nothing in San Andreas catches us.

M08_S1_02_GOHAN.line: Camera loop is active. Ice, the sentries are yours. Then Guess loads the engines.

M09_S2_04_GUESS.line: Ice, approach the stopped escort on foot. Pull its IFF unit. I'll keep watch from the Frogger.

M09_S2_05_ICE.line: Transponder secured. Code 7-Echo-Victor. We got military clearance tomorrow.

M09_S2_03_ICE.line: Escort driver down. The transponder is still in his cab.

M09_S1_02_GUESS.line: I'm taking the Frogger toward the convoy. Ice, hold the ambush point and keep the rear escort in your sights.

M09_S1_01_ICE.line: Three Insurgents north past Harmony. Middle vehicle has Vance. Rear vehicle is escort.

M10_S2_05_GUESS.line: Back in the truck. Tunnel's our way out.

M10_S2_06_GOHAN.line: Clear! Tunnel mouth ahead! Engines delivered!

M10_S2_04_ICE.line: Buzzard is out. Guess, get us moving again.

M10_S1_01_GUESS.line: Don't let me get boxed in. This truck stops, we're done.

M10_S1_02_ICE.line: Bikes coming up both sides. I've got right. Take left!

M10_S1_03_GOHAN.line: I'm watching the route from here. Keep the truck intact; those engines are our way forward.

M11_S1_03_GUESS.line: Remember when we used to hotwire clunkers behind the Davis car wash? Now we tuning aerospace turbine engines in Burro Heights.

M11_S1_04_ICE.line: Fifteen years ago you couldn't change an alternator without stripping the threads, Guess. You came a long way.

M11_S1_05_GOHAN.line: Enjoy the nostalgia while you can, boys. Aegis just docked three billion in cartel gold bullion into Berth 44. We are taking it.

M11_S1_02_ICE.line: Manifold pressure passing 25 PSI! RPM at 6,200! Exhaust temps holding green!

M11_S1_01_GUESS.line: Torque converter locked. Roll on dyno! Let's see if this military turbine tears our gearbox in half!

M12_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Breach coordinates tagged. Hull thickness eight inches. We need acoustic plasma torches.

M12_S1_02_ICE.line: Patrols are near the hull. Keep the sub deep and break their sight line.

M12_S1_01_GOHAN.line: I'm launching the sub from the jetty. Sonar sweep first, then the hull scan.

M13_S1_03_ICE.line: Charges blown! Basin is an inferno! Patrol boats burning at moorings!

M13_S1_02_GUESS.line: I'm holding the Granger at the slipway. Get aboard, then trigger the charges.

M13_S1_01_ICE.line: Charge three armed on barge hull. Guess, be ready on western canal slipway.

M14_S1_02_ICE.line: Radar coverage ahead. Stay in the dirt, under their sweep, and put it down at the airfield.

M14_S1_03_GUESS.line: Cleared the pass! Pod jammer secured in McKenzie hangar.

M14_S1_01_GUESS.line: That's the aircraft with the jammer hardware. Getting in, then taking it to McKenzie.

M15_S1_01_GOHAN.line: I'm at the fiber point. Starting the optical bypass; cover the approach.

M15_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Lock gate controls mapped to my laptop. We control port access.

M15_S1_02_ICE.line: All three watchmen stunned. Still breathing. Gohan, finish the connection.

M16_S1_03_ICE.line: Canyon's clear. Bring the lift to Terminal Island and set it down.

M16_S1_02_GUESS.line: Taking the Cargobob through the canyon. Low enough to read the license plates.

M16_S1_01_ICE.line: Helipad perimeter clear! Cargobob twin turbines spooled! Take the controls, Guess!

M17_S1_03_ICE.line: The sub is ready. Tomorrow night we hit Berth 44.

M17_S1_02_GUESS.line: Hydraulic ballast grapples tested. Fifty-ton magnetic lock verified.

M17_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Plasma-arc torches calibrated. Can slice through eight-inch naval bulkhead in four minutes.

M18_S1_01_ICE.line: Tonight we hit Berth 44, take thirty tons of their gold, and finish what started.

M18_S1_02_GUESS.line: Cargobob fueled. Just cut that container loose and I will hoist it.

M18_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Kraken sub submerged in position. Moving to Berth 44.

M19_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Depth charges dropping! Surfacing to the boarding launch!

M19_S1_02_ICE.line: Container surfacing! Guess, bring the Cargobob in now!

M19_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Breach is open. Next are the two ballast clamps. Staying in the Kraken to work them.

M20_S1_03_GUESS.line: Full cyclic forward! We are airborne and clearing the cranes!

M20_S1_01_GUESS.line: Cable locked! Hoisting thirty tons of bullion! KEEP RPGS OFF MY ROTORS!

M20_S1_02_ICE.line: Quayside gunners clear. Guess, bring the lift over the container and lock it on.

M21_S1_03_GUESS.line: Water exit clear. I'm taking the bullion north. Meet me at the Alamo.

M21_S1_02_ICE.line: Pursuit boats clear. Gohan, take the launch through the breakwater.

M21_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Running the launch alongside the lift. Ice, watch the boats. Guess, keep your route over the water.

M22_S1_02_ICE.line: Our Cypress Foundry is gone. Aegis just leveled the entire city block with precision cruise missiles.

M22_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Servers, tools, clothes... everything we set up in Los Santos is ash. They declared us military combatants.

M22_S1_04_GUESS.line: They burned our city shop? Fine. They don't know who they dealing with out here in the dirt. Blaine County belongs to us now.

M22_S1_05_ICE.line: We need shelter before another strike. That radar site in the desert is our next move.

M22_S1_06_GOHAN.line: They know our names now. We take care of each other, and we take back the initiative.

M22_S1_01_GUESS.line: Container detached! Thirty tons of bullion sitting safe in four feet of Alamo water.

M23_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Generator room online. We have our command center in the desert.

M23_S1_02_GUESS.line: The three storage bays are secure. We can stage the heavy rigs in this yard.

M23_S1_01_ICE.line: Breaching upper radar dome. Four cartel riflemen on walkway.

M24_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Crates loaded! Cash reserves replenished for Blaine operations.

M24_S1_01_GUESS.line: First five tons recovered. Secure the haul; it still has to reach the radar base.

M24_S1_02_ICE.line: Sheriff cruisers coming over the ridge! They aren't taking this haul!

M25_S1_03_ICE.line: In the boat. Getting out of this gorge before another wave arrives.

M25_S1_02_GUESS.line: The extraction boat is waiting below, Ice. Use the parachute; I'll talk you down over the radio.

M25_S1_01_ICE.line: Deputies blocked the southern pass. Detonating fuel tanker on bridge.

M26_S1_03_GUESS.line: Both spotters down in the lake! Our Alamo stash remains a ghost.

M26_S1_02_GOHAN.line: Spotter one splashed! Spotter two is diving for Grapeseed-kill him!

M26_S1_01_GUESS.line: Two spotters over the Alamo. Taking the Lazer up to stop them finding our stash.

M27_S2_06_GUESS.line: You made the pickup. That ledger tells us who keeps Aegis in the air.

M27_S2_04_GOHAN.line: The jet is losing its nose. Ice, bail out now and pull the chute. I've got the boat under you.

M27_S2_05_ICE.line: Ledger secured. Clear of the jet. Gohan, keep the boat where I can see it.

M27_S2_03_ICE.line: The ledger is in this locker. Hold the jet steady while I secure it.

M27_S1_01_GUESS.line: Taking the stunt plane up. I'll sit on the Shamal's wing close enough for the transfer. Say if it isn't close enough.

M27_S1_02_ICE.line: Transfer complete. In the cabin. Going for the flight locker.

SM01_S2_05_ICE.line: Crates loaded in the trunk. Armor-piercing tungsten-core 7.62. Gohan and Guess have what they need.

SM01_S2_03_ENEMY.line: Vance! Put the gun down! We can work something out, brother!

SM01_S2_04_ICE.line: We aren't brothers, Sergei. And your credit just expired.

SM01_S1_02_ICE.line: Six guards between me and Sergei. I'm clearing the floor before I ask for the codes.

SM01_S1_01_ICE.line: Sergei thought he could pocket twenty grand and hand me surplus civilian brass. Time to remind him who taught him logistics.

SM02_S2_04_GOHAN.line: Slip down the fire escape before internal IT notices the packet spike. Clean and invisible.

SM02_S2_03_GOHAN.line: Worm installed. Camera archive access is ours. Getting out before IT traces the connection.

SM02_S1_02_GOHAN.line: Two guards between me and the server room. Stun gun first; the thermal pulse finds them for me.

SM02_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Lifeinvader annex. Roof first, then both guards go down quiet. Nobody needs to die for a camera archive.

SM03_S2_03_ENEMY.line: We lost the race! Shoot his tires before he leaves!

SM03_S2_04_GUESS.line: They pulled guns after losing. I can stop them or get the coupe back to the finish.

SM03_S2_05_GUESS.line: Checkered flag! Title is in my pocket and the racing transmission is loaded on the truck.

SM03_S1_02_GUESS.line: Three laps. KJ, keep an eye on their line.

SM03_S1_01_GUESS.line: Marabunta thinks their tuned Elegy has the top end. They don't know who is behind this wheel.

M01_S1_03_GUESS.line: Bay two. Keys are in the prototype. Someone expected a driver tonight. I am in.
M01_S1_03_GUESS.trigger: Guess takes the actual prototype driver seat

M01_S3_09_GOHAN.line: The copy is here, but half the entries are encrypted. Their security recorded all three of us. We need somewhere to open this.

M05_S2_04_ENEMY.line: Aegis paid us to keep that dock hot. Three crews. Three contracts. They wanted all three of you there.

M05_S2_05_GOHAN.line: Why us? He doesn't know. But whoever signed it has city money behind them. Police, port authority... somebody put us in that dock on purpose.

M70_S1_01_ICE.line: Fifteen years on our own roads. Tonight we hold this ground.

M70_S1_06_GUESS.line: Told y'all it still had engines.
